articles.title: Why petrol and diesel prices stayed stable in India despite global oil shock amid Iran war, Hardeep Puri explains
articles.titleEn: Why petrol and diesel prices stayed stable in India despite global oil shock amid Iran war, Hardeep Puri explains
articles.summary: India avoided a sharp petrol and diesel price hike despite global fuel prices rising 50-60% amid geopolitical tensions. Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri attributed this to three excise duty cuts, including a ₹10-per-litre reduction in March 2026.
articles.summaryEn: India avoided a sharp petrol and diesel price hike despite global fuel prices rising 50-60% amid geopolitical tensions. Petroleum Minister Hardeep Singh Puri attributed this to three excise duty cuts, including a ₹10-per-litre reduction in March 2026.

articles.title: UK inflation rises to 3.6% as petrol and diesel prices climb
articles.titleEn: UK inflation rises to 3.6% as petrol and diesel prices climb
articles.summary: Higher fuel prices pushed UK inflation up from 3.5% in September to 3.6% in October. Diesel hit a record high, while prices for food and non-alcoholic drinks rose at their slowest pace in five years.
articles.summaryEn: Higher fuel prices pushed UK inflation up from 3.5% in September to 3.6% in October. Diesel hit a record high, while prices for food and non-alcoholic drinks rose at their slowest pace in five years.
articles.body:
Annual inflation in the UK rose to 3.6% in October, up from 3.5% the previous month, largely driven by the jump in the cost of motor fuels.
